RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are men, meaning sex could not have been the deciding factor between you. Raising the panel's gender composition would lack substantive grounds and could damage your professional reputation. 

While an all-male panel may reflect poor procedural diversity or institutional shortcomings, it is not evidence of discrimination against you. The decision more likely hinged on the department's specific curriculum needs (such as practical industry experience), interview performance, or departmental fit. 

Instead of mentioning gender, follow up politely on your request for written feedback, focusing purely on how your qualifications aligned with the selection criteria and how you can strengthen future applications.
